events.note: USNO: nautical twilight ends 21:34 UT and astronomical twilight ends 22:29 UT on 20 June, which is 00:29 CEST on 21 June, after local midnight. The 19 June astronomical dusk at 22:28 UT falls inside the window but closes no span, and the 21 June one falls outside it
